answer_2.quote: In objective evaluation, we use Mean Cepstral Distortion (MCD) and Mean Spectral Distortion (MSD) to evaluate the timbral distortion of synthesized audio. We also select Gross Pitch Error (GPE), Voicing Decision Error (VDE), and F0 Frame Error (FFE) to evaluate the F0 track in synthesized audio.

answer_4.quote: For subjective evaluation, we conduct a Mean Opinion Score (MOS) for both real and synthesized audio in the test set... 10 volunteers participated in the evaluation without disclosing the audio source.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated the naturalness of each audio sample on a 1–5 scale.
